The app wouldn't accept the contact. It objects to the **Email** field, `jane.doe@`.

- **Save button:** Save is greyed out and disabled. That was the case even with First name, Last name, Company (Laboratory Corporation of America Holdings) and Status (Imported lead) all filled in. I didn't try to force the save.
- **Other fields:** None of them were flagged.

I clicked Cancel to close the form, so nothing was saved. I didn't re-check the contact list afterward.
